editor.premise: Watch a nature-inspired short film, then see how its shots were made with a compact camera and practical shooting choices.

chapters.name: Nature film
chapters.purpose: Establish the finished visual language before explaining how it was achieved.

chapters.name: Making the images
chapters.purpose: Connect equipment and shooting decisions to recognizable finished shots.

captions.note: Small bottom-centered lines follow narration across cuts; centered chapter headings and occasional top labels distinguish explanations from finished examples.

editor.notes: Show the finished image before explaining it, then pair the setup with its result. Keep illustrative inserts brief; hold difficult staging longer. Repeated compositions let viewers recognize exactly what each practical choice produced.
